text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-ops-117","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCoMn_OER_crystallinity_sweep_v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_manager","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2291","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Standard FTO plate swap for OER screening"},{"server":"plate_manager","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"Verify plate identity before deposition"},{"server":"plate_manager","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2291"},"comment":"Routine init"},{"server":"deposition","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,20,0,0,10,40,0,5,5,0],"thickness":150},"comment":"NiFeCoMn baseline with Sn/Ta stabilizers, nominal thickness"},{"server":"furnace","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":700,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Crystallization step; setpoint within approved FTO profile (label: SOP-ANN-STD)"},{"server":"electrochem","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,20,0,0,10,40,0,5,5,0]},"comment":"Single-point check post-anneal"},{"server":"electrochem","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,20,0,0,10,40,0,5,5,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"Chronopotentiometry at default rate"},{"server":"electrochem","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,20,0,0,10,40,0,5,5,0],"duration":2},"comment":"Short stability check"},{"server":"ml","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"FTO-2291"},"comment":"Ingest results"}]}
